entries.title: Prove a storage slot
entries.story: USDC's slot 0 proven from the beacon root: SSZ branch to the execution state root, then the account and storage tries.

entries.title: Prove the whole payload
entries.story: State root, receipts root, block number and block hash in one 14-helper multiproof, 17 hashes instead of 48.

entries.title: Prove a transaction outcome
entries.story: A receipt from the block's receipt trie: status, gas used, type and log count, anchored through the beacon root.

entries.title: Prove an event log
entries.story: One emitted event, address and topics and data hash, proven out of the receipt trie.

entries.title: Prove a validator record
entries.story: A whole validator record, all eight fields, proven from the registry fifty hash levels deep.

entries.title: Prove yesterday's block root
entries.story: An older block root from the state's 8,192-slot window, one more branch from the same anchor.

entries.title: Prove a 2023 block root
entries.story: A block root from the first Capella period, 3.6 years back, through the frozen historical summaries.
